notes: kb/Work PB5871: §2002:12.3.4.2 SR7 'Data-name-1 shall reference an alphanumeric data item and shall not be subordinate to the file description entry for file-name-1.' ResolveAssignUsing asks ItemCategory.IsAlphanumeric(item, edition): an alphabetic (PIC A) item stands as alphanumeric at COBOL-2002 alone (§2002:8.5.2.1, 'Where an alphabetic data item is not expressly permitted, the alphabetic data item is treated as though it were an alphanumeric data item'; EditionInfo.AlphabeticIsAlphanumeric), so the PIC A operand of the note's repro (g2asg06) compiles at --std 2002, names the file, and the record is written and read back; COBOL-2014 withdrew the sentence (§2014:E.2), so the same source is COBOL1810 at 2014 and 2023 (the golden's refusal twin pb5871-assign-using-alphabetic-refused). A numeric operand (pb324) and an item inside the file's own record stay refused at every edition. The message cites the rule of the edition compiled.
